
== Books ==
* Pre-introductory is Jay's [[Jay's Lojban Brochure|Jay's Lojban Brochure]].
* People who send a postcard to the LLG receive the [[Level -1 flyer]].
* For a more detailed introduction, please see [[User:Nick Nicholas|Nick Nicholas]] and [[John Cowan|John Cowan]]'s ''[http://lojban.org/publications/level0.html hat is Lojban?]'', which has become the [[Level 0 Booklet]] for [[The Logical Language Group|The Logical Language Group]], and is available from [http://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/tg/detail/-/0966028317/qid=1062895255/sr=8-1/ref=sr_8_1/102-4826386-3031311?v=glance&amp;s=books&amp;n=507846 mazon Books]. There is an incomplete PDF of [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-download_wiki_attachment.php?attId=89 he first 19 pages of the Level 0 Booklet], a project in progress, which typesets and illustrates the diagrams with nested tables.
* Next there is ''[http://ptolemy.tlg.uci.edu/~opoudjis/lojbanbrochure/lessons/book1.html ojban For Beginners]'' (the "[[lessons|lessons]]"), by [[Robin Turner|Robin Turner]] and Nick Nicholas, currently being edited by Nick Nicholas.
** Robin Turner wrote [http://www.bilkent.edu.tr/~robin/lojbancourse.html ome lessons], but they were used as the basis for the above ''Lojban For Beginners'', which is more complete.
* Finally, the '''ultimate''' educational resource is the canonical text [[The Complete Lojban Language|The Complete Lojban Language]], available in paper from the [[The Logical Language Group|The Logical Language Group]], or in draft form [http://lojban.org/publications/reference_grammar.html n line].

----
* A [[phrasebook|phrasebook]] is being compiled.
* [[Multimedia|Multimedia]] and other materials which aren't purely textual (sound recordings)
* [[.i tavla fi la lojban ri|.i tavla fi la lojban ri]], an in-progress list of easy-to-use vocabulary intended to facilitate talking about Lojban in Lojban.
* There is a [http://www.lojban.org/files/roadmap.html#draft-textbook raft textbook] by [[User:Bob LeChevalier|Bob LeChevalier]], which hasn't been updated in a very long time.
